title: Parameter-efficient Modularised Bias Mitigation via AdapterFusion

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the leakage of gender information from the model's latent representations by training an adversarial classification head (attacker) to predict binary gender categories using the BIOS and PAN16 datasets.

Evaluating the leakage of dialect-based racial identity from the model's latent representations by training an adversarial classification head (attacker) to predict race (African American vs. White American) using the FDCL18 hate speech dataset.
Evaluating the leakage of age group information from the model's latent representations by training an adversarial classification head (attacker) to predict age categories using the PAN16 dataset.
